summary: Phase 19 is implemented at the Blender adapter boundary. RenderIntent compiles into immutable, versioned PREVIEW/FINAL/FINAL_HIGH BlenderRenderProfile settings; FINAL uses Cycles and non-Cycles hints fail closed instead of silently switching to Eevee. The capability probe now enumerates OptiX, CUDA, and CPU across both GPU backends. Device selection prefers OptiX then CUDA, records requested/selected/actual device, and blocks implicit CPU fallback unless an explicit ALLOW policy produces CPU_FALLBACK_APPROVED. Profiles pin resolution, fps, samples, adaptive threshold, denoise, bounce budgets, motion blur/shutter, measured persistent-data evidence, instancing, spatial splits, LOD/texture/geometry limits, seed, film/color settings, PNG/EXR output, post-production contract, and dependency hashes. Render cache identity covers scene/shot/frame/profile/Blender/device/dependencies and artifact class; preview manifests cannot satisfy or promote to final. The trusted executor applies the profile, fails closed on schema/output/device mismatch, publishes atomic frame sequences, and records per-frame/chunk seconds, sample cap, best-effort peak memory, actual device, and failure. A real Blender 4.5.12 LTS run on the RTX 5060 selected and actually used OptiX, rendered one 320x180 PNG frame at 4 samples in 1.789472 seconds, and passed all hash/dimension/profile/cache/telemetry checks. Test matrix: 115 passed, 0 failed; Ruff passed.
